description: Data payload shape of '<domain>.status' commands, i.e. the data member of the envelope. The inline element definitions keep this schema self-contained; see contract/README.md.

domain.description: Domain that produced this status, e.g. 'mcp' or 'skills'.

elements.description: One entry per managed element of the domain.

import_candidates.description: MCP domain only: unmanaged server entries found in configured agent target files, offered for import into the library. Each spec is masked — env and static header values are always '<literal>', only Codex env_http_headers pass through as ${VAR} references; plaintext secret values never appear. Read-only, zero-write.

recommendations.description: Skills domain only: compiled-in recommended skill sources. Read-only catalog, never elements, never counted as pending sync, never probed or fetched. Adding one saves its 'definition' as an ordinary collection (no agents restriction, no assignment).

installed.description: Skills domain only: actual entries found in each agent's skills directory (the current view), classified by the same scanner as system:discover. Display only, not pending items. Read-only, zero-write.

name.description: Collection name used when the recommendation is added.

url.description: Git repository URL of the source.

added.description: True when a non-deleted collection with the same name or URL already exists; the UI then offers no add action.

definition.description: Collection definition written on add: url and skill_paths only (no agents, no assignment).

skill_installed_entry.description: One direct child of an agent's skills directory (hidden entries skipped).

agent.description: Agent id whose skills directory holds the entry.

name.description: Entry name (skill directory or link name).

target.description: Symlink target ('~/...' when under HOME); null for real directories.

origin.description: managed = link written by this tool (assigned binding, target inside a managed base); native-dir = real directory; external-link / collection-extra-link = link to an outside path; legacy-link = unassigned link into a managed base; dead-link = link whose target is gone.

collection.description: Owning collection for managed entries, or the matching collection for collection-extra-link; otherwise null.

import_candidate.description: One unmanaged MCP server entry discovered in an agent's existing config file.

name.description: Server entry name as found in the client config; guaranteed to pass server-name validation.

agent.description: Canonical agent id whose target file holds the entry, e.g. 'claude-code' or 'codex'.

spec.description: Masked definition shape: stdio {command, args, env:{KEY:'<literal>'}}; remote {url, headers:{NAME:'<literal>'|'${VAR}'}}.

element.description: Engine Contract v1 element model. Each managed object is exposed with observed state, freshness and the actions currently offered by the engine.

spec.description: Definition shape held by the native manager. Free-form per domain.

policy.description: Effective policy result from builtin defaults and SQLite. Free-form per domain.

observed.description: Physical state probed at runtime. Free-form per domain.

state.description: Convergence state derived from desired and observed values.

actions.description: Actions the engine offers for this element; the GUI renders buttons from this list only.

freshness.description: Upstream freshness block. Value fields are required but nullable: 'not-applicable' and never-probed 'unknown' elements carry nulls. Status commands read only cached probe data (SQLite upstream_probes table in native-manager.db; a missing table or row reads as 'unknown' and is never created on the read path) and never hit the network; system.refresh-upstream is the only writer of fresh values.

state.description: Upstream axis state. 'unknown' is a first-class state: probes that failed or never ran; convergence conservatively skips downloads in this state.

upstream.description: Upstream latest version/commit as of 'checked_at', or null.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last upstream probe, or null when never probed.

probe.description: Probe mechanism that produced the upstream value, e.g. 'npm-view' or 'git-ls-remote', or null.

cache_age_sec.description: Age of the cached probe result in seconds at render time, or null when there is no cached result.

action.description: One element-level action offered by the engine.

risk.description: Risk level: read < write-local < exec-local < network < install-remove.

needs_lock.description: true when executing this action requires the engine lock.

offline_ok.description: true when this action is allowed in offline mode.
